design_issues.screen: Premium Numerology PDF · Numerology Overview table
issues: Naamank 'Name' column renders as 'Ketu (Ketu (South Node))' — the builder concatenates entry.planet + '(' + entry.planet_english + ')' but for Ketu both fields already contain the word 'Ketu', producing a redundant duplicate. Suggest either using only planet_english when planet is already a substring of it, or dropping the parenthetical when they overlap. Cosmetic only — the row is still readable and traits/essence render correctly. Sun/Moon/Venus/Jupiter etc are unaffected because their Sanskrit and English names differ.

action_items: Optional cosmetic polish in /app/frontend/src/lib/pdfBuilders.js drawNumerologyCore: when entry.planet is already contained inside entry.planet_english (case-insensitive substring), render just entry.planet_english to avoid 'Ketu (Ketu (South Node))'. E.g. `const planet = e.planet_english ? (e.planet && !e.planet_english.toLowerCase().includes(e.planet.toLowerCase()) ? \`${e.planet} (${e.planet_english})\` : e.planet_english) : (e.planet || '—');`
